name: tile-flip
description: Tile Flip - hinged 3D tile wall (Remotion + Three.js, 4K comps)

scripts.render:1080p: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
scripts.render:4k: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run render:v2:4k
scripts.downscale:v1: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/TileFlip-V1_4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -an -movflags +faststart out/TileFlip-V1_1080p.mp4
scripts.downscale:v2: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/TileFlip-V2_4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -an -movflags +faststart out/TileFlip-V2_1080p.mp4
scripts.master:v1: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run downscale:v1
scripts.master:v2: npm run render:v2:4k && npm run downscale:v2
scripts.master: npm run master:v1 && npm run master:v2
